title: Refiling Fee on Discounted Early Retirement Requests — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) Member Terms
content:
# Refiling Fee on Discounted Early Retirement Requests

**Member terms — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital).** A member who withdrew or was denied an earlier discounted early retirement request on the account pays a refiling fee once per request, deducted from the first row booked under the approved request:

| Earlier discounted early retirement requests on the account that were withdrawn or denied | Refiling fee |
|---|---|
| none (a first-time request) | none |
| exactly one | $5.00 |
| two or more | $10.00 |

## Conditions explained

- **Which earlier requests count.** Discounted early retirement requests on the same capital account whose status is withdrawn or denied. Withdrawn and denied requests are counted together.
- **Once per request.** The fee is taken a single time for the approved request, from the first row booked under it. Whether a row is the first is read from the account: it is the first when no payable entry of the discounted early type for that approved request stands on the account yet. Rows booked after it carry no refiling fee.
- **Where the fee goes.** The fee is deducted from that row's payable.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Earlier withdrawn | Earlier denied | Payable entries of this request already on the account | Fee on this row |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | none | none |
| 1 | 0 | none | $5.00 |
| 0 | 1 | none | $5.00 |
| 1 | 1 | none | $10.00 |
| 0 | 3 | none | $10.00 |
| 1 | 1 | one | none — the fee was carried by the first row |
